crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign…
Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

people.name: Lamech
people.line: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible

translations.web: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”
translations.bsb: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold.”
translations.kjv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
translations.asv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
